# Folder Structure

| .prettierrc.json - prettier formatting file  
| .eslintrc.cjs - linter configuration only comment out linting rules if there a good reason  
| .gitignore - ignored files for source control  
| src - source for the api application  


# Getting started with Local Development

# Environment

-   Latest version of [NVM](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm)
-   Latest version of NodeJS 18.x `nvm install 18`
-   Latest version of [AWS CLI](https://aws.amazon.com/cli/)
-   Latest version of [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/)
-   Assigned AWS accounts and IAM credentials
-   [Redoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc#redoc-cli) for automatically generating html from the open api specification, see install [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/25800493/converting-swagger-specification-json-to-html-documentation)
-   Latest version of [Kind](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/) for the local integration test enviornment, see install [here](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/#installation)
-   Latest version of [Helm](https://helm.sh/) see the install guild [here](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/)

For the remainng item of this list, you should figure out yourself if you don't already know.

-   [Git](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Getting-Started-Installing-Git)
-   A good terminal (such as [iTerm2](https://iterm2.com/index.html) + [ohmyzsh](https://ohmyz.sh/))
-   A good IDE (such as [VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/), or [WebStorm](https://www.jetbrains.com/webstorm/))
-   Helpful for command line navigation [z](https://facilecode.com/how-to-setup-z-jump-around/)

# Setup

1. Configure AWS CLI. `aws configure`. See sample config below. Use _us-east-1_ as default region and _json_ as default output format.

```bash
aws configure

```

steps.message:
All checks pass. Here's a summary of the change:

**Problem:** `SettingsService.update` persisted the customer's `cloudIAM` scraper role (role ARN + external id) blindly — an unusable role was written, and there was no notion of disconnect vs. an invalid block.

**Implementation:**

1. `src/utils/aws/awsSts.ts` (new) — `assumeRole({ iamRoleArn, externalId })` performs a real `sts:AssumeRole` (external id passed only when supplied) and returns the temporary credentials; `defaultRegion()` helper. Uses the default client config, so it talks to the preconfigured `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL` emulator.

2. `src/setting/dto/cloudIAMAuthorizer.ts` (new):
   - `verifyCloudIAMAccess` — proves the role is assumable with the supplied external id, then proves *the returned credentials* can read the instance inventory by running the very same `DescribeInstances` read collection uses (`getInstanceWithFilters`). Either failure raises `CloudIAMValidationException` (a `BadRequestException` whose response body is a `message` array, so HTTP clients see `400` + `message[0]` mentioning IAM, while `error.message` stays readable for logs/tests).
   - `validateCloudIAMSettings` — normalises/validates the block: absent block = no-op; blank `iamRoleArn` = disconnect, returning `{ iamRoleArn: '' }` so the external id is cleared; a block that names no role (`{}`, `{ externalId }`, `null`, non-object) = bad request, never a disconnect; anything else must pass both proofs.
   - `ValidCloudIAM()` class-validator decorator so the same rules reject the request at the validation-pipe layer with a `400`.

3. `src/setting/dto/update-settings.dto.ts` — `cloudIAM` now uses `@ValidateIf(... !== undefined)` (so `null` is validated rather than skipped) plus `@ValidCloudIAM()` alongside the existing nested validation.

4. `src/setting/settings.service.ts` — validates/normalises `cloudIAM` at the very top of `update`, before reading settings, writing influx points, changing schedulers or refreshing the cache, so a failed check means nothing in that save is written.

5. `src/utils/aws/awsEc2.ts` — null-safe `Reservations` handling in `getInstanceWithFilters`.

6. `src/setting/cloudIAMValidation.spec.ts` (new) — creates roles in the local emulator (assumable+inventory read, assumable+inventory denied) and asserts: valid role saved, unassumable role/mismatched external id rejected with nothing written, inventory-denied role rejected with nothing written, blank role disconnects and clears the external id, role-less block rejected, and non-`cloudIAM` saves unaffected.
